snapshots.name: Bucket Screen — Initial State
snapshots.purpose: Default landing state: bucket interface, idle, no draws yet. Baseline for review of bucket screen layout, header, bucket button, footer messaging.

snapshots.name: Card Screen — After Draw
snapshots.purpose: Review card display after successful draw: switched to card screen, drawPhase=revealed, card flipped=false (front), drawCount incremented, recent includes drawn stick. Shows primary card interface and interaction state.

snapshots.name: Card Screen — Back Side Visible
snapshots.purpose: Card flipped to back (red question side). Tests flip state toggle and footer hint text change to 'not want this one' variant. Validates flip interaction branch.

snapshots.name: Card Screen — Return Animation
snapshots.purpose: drawPhase=returning state during card flyback animation. Tests animation class and button disabled state during return. Validates return phase visual state.

snapshots.name: Bucket Screen — After Multiple Draws
snapshots.purpose: Back at bucket screen after returning: drawCount=2, recent tracking multiple indices, footer metrics updated. Tests state recovery and metrics display after round-trip.
